title: Why Airplane Windows Have That Tiny Hole
alternate_titles: That Tiny Hole Isn't a Leak
The Tiny Hole That Protects Airplane Windows
description:
That tiny hole in an airplane window isn't a leak. It helps control which pane carries the pressure difference during flight.
